report:
I cannot identify any specific objective or domain from this evidence.

What I do see:
- The difference is overwhelmingly concentrated at position 0 across essentially all layers (p0 dwarfs p1–p4), which is typical of a global offset at the sequence start (e.g., a changed BOS/position embedding or added “system” vector), not a learned task or domain feature.
- The logit-lens top tokens pointed to by the difference are an eclectic mix with no coherent theme: at pos0 lots of proper nouns/brands (“TMZ”, “DJI”, “Playboy”), random nouns (“reefs”, “scammers”, “hatchback”), and odd morphemes (“iasis”). For later positions, many generic, capitalized “header-like” tokens (“Summary”, “Outcome”, “File”, “Computation”, “Students”, “HDTV”, “MPEG”). This looks like a broad principal-component/style shift rather than a targeted capability.
- Patchscope readouts are absent, so there’s no behavioral continuation evidence.

Most consistent interpretation: Model B differs from A primarily by a representational shift injected at the first token (e.g., BOS/positional/embedding bias), which then propagates, rather than by a change in training objective or domain behavior.
